before.name: Roy Kepler
before.description: Roy Cecil Kepler was a pacifist and founder of Kepler’s Books in Menlo Park. Local reporting documents jail for a 1960 anti-nuclear protest and an October 1967 Oakland anti-draft arrest. A retrospective describes Santa Rita confinement and a trespass plea in the 1960 episode. His subsequent public career establishes completed historical custody. Archival records distinguish his WWII Civilian Public Service camp service from these later jail episodes. A memorial identifies his death in 1994, without an exact day used here. Sources: https://findingaids.library.upenn.edu/records/Peace_SCPC.DG.185 ; https://www.almanacnews.com/morgue/2005/2005_05_04.keplersa.shtml ; https://a3mreunion.org/remembrance/kepler-r.html
